coverage: Seed signed genesis, member grant, pull request, comment, session opening and production using production hub/trust APIs on native Cloudflare stores.
Namespace capture/restore preserves all Git object bytes and refs alongside SQL/KV/R2 and authorization metadata.
After target eviction, production trust and hub projections match source; PR and trust projections have no rejected events.
Session prompt, production links, note and usage survive in the projected state.
Stock Git verifies all restored objects and explicitly fetches refs/meta/* and refs/hub/* into a fresh clone.
Verification precedes target release; the verification-report digest records hub projection success.
limits: Local native fixture only; no deployed Cloudflare HTTP recovery or installation-wide isolation proof.
Basic signed hub histories are covered, not every redaction, revocation or concurrent history scenario.
Complete supported-installation recovery, operator policy and production recovery targets remain open.
